title: The two sides of 2D materials properties: a perspective on balancing air quality applications with environmental and health risks of 2D materials
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6VA00035E, Perspective
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tse-Lun Chen, Yizhou Zhang, Ying Kong, Jing Wang
This perspective presents a “safety-and-sustainability-by-design” roadmap for 2D materials in air technologies, balancing high-performance applications such as sensing and purification with a deep understanding of life-cycle and toxicological risks.
